links.label: What is test management? A complete guide

items.q: What is a test management tool?
items.a: A test management tool is software where QA teams plan, write, run and track test cases and link them to requirements and defects.

items.q: How does AI help with test management?
items.a: TestMu AI agents draft test cases from stories, detect duplicates on import, group cases into plans and link automated results to the right cases.

items.q: Does Test Manager integrate with Jira?
items.a: Yes. Test Manager has two-way sync with Jira and Azure DevOps for defects, status and requirements.

items.q: Can I import test cases from another tool?
items.a: Yes. Import from spreadsheets and other test management tools. Duplicates are matched during import.

items.q: How much does Test Manager cost?
items.a: The Free Forever plan includes unlimited projects and test cases. Test Manager Premium starts at $49 per user per month, billed annually.
